recompute_depth.label: recomputes from its own bytes + independently admitted by invinoveritas's published key; the external anchor (pre-outcome precedence) is the /ledger + OTS leg, not checked by /verify-proof

how_to_verify: Recompute the Nostr event id = sha256(JSON [0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content]); verify the schnorr sig over it against pubkey; confirm pubkey == published_pubkey. Standard NIP-01 — do it yourself. The content is RFC 8785 JCS (sorted keys, compact separators, raw UTF-8 / not \uXXXX-escaped) so the canonical bytes recompute identically across implementations.

proof_payload.decision_ref_preimage_rule: every name in decision_ref_preimage_fields is a key in the hashed preimage object, always -- absent fields (e.g. vantage_limitation when not applicable) are present as JSON null, never omitted from the object.
proof_payload.verify_how: Easiest: install the offline verifier above and recompute locally. Or POST this proof's signed `event` to verify_url (or an independent_node), OR run NIP-01 yourself: recompute the Nostr event id = sha256([0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content]), verify the schnorr signature against verifier_pubkey. valid ⇒ invinoveritas issued this, untampered. No trust required.
proof_payload.verify_offline: npm i invinoveritas-verify  ·  pip install invinoveritas-verify  — recompute this proof on your own machine against verifier_pubkey; you never have to call us.

scope_note: A valid proof confirms invinoveritas issued this verdict — NOT that it's fresh or meant for YOUR interaction. Check `age_seconds` for recency and pass `expect_artifact_hash` to bind the proof to the exact output you received.
get_your_own: Want your own output trusted like this? POST /review with {"sign": true} to get a portable signed verdict proof to attach to what you ship. The norm both ways: demand a proof on what you receive, attach one to what you ship — that's how trust spreads agent-to-agent. Skill: integrations/agentskills/verification-handshake.
